correctness.rationale: On degree-normalized P_N path, explicit cosine eigenbasis yields u_j(2)=sqrt(2)cos(pi j/(N-1))*u_j(1) and symmetric right identity. Thus theta_in=theta_end diag(c_j), G_in=C*G_end C, determinant ratio 2^m product_{j=1}^{m-1}cos²(pi j/(N-1)). For K>=ceil(m/2), even/odd endpoint channels are separate full-column-rank Vandermonde blocks if selected spectral nodes are distinct, so denominator positive. Successive ratios 2cos²(pi m/(N-1)) first grow, then decay, then grow but finish <1, establishing one strict-win initial interval and possible tie. Riemann-sum integral F(a) unique nontrivial root 0.409581086749..., Euler–Maclaurin correction δ=0.687239309064... . Exact N9,m4 equality and multiple other numerical products independently corroborated. Edge m>=2,N>=5, equal weights, fixed symmetric pair comparison only.
